name: Chisa
source:
She is an idol from the same agency as Aina and is Aina's junior. Like Aina, she was having trouble buying what she wanted because her parents took her salary.

Aina approached her when she was worried about not being able to buy what she wanted. She has a calm personality and likes to read fashion magazines. 

She has slightly larger boobs than Aina.

[From [url=http://www.soft-parthenon.com/product/lovedl/character.html]official site[/url]]
